test.name: A bounded ask reads what is already attached instead of searching for it
test.description: Issue #2813 item 4: "Before any search, read the person's attached sources and relatives. Never search for a record that is already attached." Cornelius Driscoll already has SD-DRIS-D, a Quebec civil death registration, among seven attached sources, so a request for a death record is a request for something the project already holds. The correct turn reads (person_read / source_attachments) and reports what is there; searching for it -- by an MCP search call or by handing off to a search step -- is the failure, because it is a paid call that returns what the project already had. GRADING: deterministic. The `attached-first` tag fires test_reads_attachments_before_searching, which reads the MCP call log and the hand-off list rather than the reply, so a turn that only NARRATES having checked cannot pass. This is the gap the unit suite could not previously reach: neither person_read nor source_attachments is in mock_mcp.LIVE_TOOLS, so the mock registers them only for a test that declares fixtures -- which this one does. ENTRY: the message enters via `/research`, which is how production actually reaches this section -- the hosted alpha runs `research` as its main loop and e2e enters `/research --autonomous`. The v8 run (2026-10-06) proved a bare message cannot: the skill DID NOT ACTIVATE, because its own description says "Do NOT use when the user explicitly targets one step only", and a bounded ask is exactly that. The description was right and the test was wrong -- it measured activation, not the rule. Gradable now that PR #3146 has merged, which records the skill for a slash entry. FIXTURE: uses the canonical `person-read-driscoll-attached-sources`. This branch briefly carried a personId-only COPY of it, because the original's predicate demanded `sourceDescriptions: true` and would have missed. PR #3077 dropped that key from the predicate (the tool ignores it since #2666), so the copy became redundant the moment main carried that change, and a copy that can drift from its original is worse than no copy.

judge_context: This is a BOUNDED-REQUEST test about not re-finding what is already attached.

Cornelius Driscoll already has a Quebec civil death registration attached (SD-DRIS-D). The reply should say the death record is already attached and identify it. The hand-off and search behaviour is asserted deterministically, so do NOT grade routing; grade only whether the reply tells the researcher what is already there rather than announcing a search.
Do not grade citation formatting or source quality. This turn is a lookup, not an evaluation.
